sheets.label: L-(42) Karsakpay · Geological map, 1:1,000,000
sheets.name: L-(42) Karsakpay
sheets.credit: From the professor's shared collection of Soviet geological maps (Kazakhstan maps). Scan only.
sheets.license: Rights remain with the original authors or rightsholders. Shared with this project as a teaching collection; no open license established. These scan-derived tiles are not covered by the repository code license.
sheets.accuracy: Four frame corners read by hand from the L-(42) nomenclature (Pulkovo 1942 to WGS84), projective fit. Expect errors of a few hundred metres; corner residual check 14.5 px.
sheets.limitations: Scan only, no color classification. Clipped to the Kazakhstan border. Historic labels and boundaries are retained as printed.
